Description: RAFS host-test overlay (internal-contracts Part V §80.3), merged by test/support/Facet-RAFS-Harness.js into a CLONE of the fixture model (the fixture files are never edited). Identity: the Kit identity shape (login account, persona join, entitlement role tables). Probes: one table per tenancy coverage class of §75.2, per fixture (anchored on two fixture entities so each probe can be a root, a hop and a label target).

RFSAccount.Description: Login principal (Auth.Local.UserTable): one global account per human, no tenant column. NoAutoCRUD.

RFSMembership.Description: Account x tenant persona join (Auth.Local.MembershipTable, entitlements IdentityTable, membership PersonaTable): IDUser is the fixture persona. NoAutoCRUD.

Role.Description: Entitlements role, per tenant (Kit shape). Mounted, tenancy-scoped.

RoleAction.Description: One action key a Role grants (Kit shape). Mounted, tenancy-scoped.

UserRole.Description: Grants a Role to a persona within a tenant (Kit shape). Mounted, tenancy-scoped.

UserAction.Description: A direct per-persona grant or deny (deny wins) (Kit shape). NoAutoCRUD.

ProbeDenied.Description: Probe (LabTrack): Mounted and tenancy-guarded, but under a tenancy DeniedPrefix (/1.0/ProbeDenied).

ProbeExcluded.Description: Probe (LabTrack): Mounted, in Tenancy.Exclude, WITH the tenancy column: Excluded (not facetable unless opted in).

ProbeGlobal.Description: Probe (LabTrack): Mounted, in Tenancy.Exclude, no tenancy column, in Catalog.GlobalEntities: Global.

ProbeLate.Description: Probe (LabTrack): Mounted by a route installer AFTER tenancy (late mount) WITH the tenancy column: Unguarded, never facetable.

ProbeLateGlobal.Description: Probe (LabTrack): Late mount without the tenancy column, in Catalog.GlobalEntities: Unguarded Global.

ProbeLink.Description: Probe (LabTrack): Installed (tenancy-guarded) table whose FKs point at every probe, so each probe is a label target and a parent hop.

ProbeDenied.Description: Probe (ProjectTrack): Mounted and tenancy-guarded, but under a tenancy DeniedPrefix (/1.0/ProbeDenied).

ProbeExcluded.Description: Probe (ProjectTrack): Mounted, in Tenancy.Exclude, WITH the tenancy column: Excluded (not facetable unless opted in).

ProbeGlobal.Description: Probe (ProjectTrack): Mounted, in Tenancy.Exclude, no tenancy column, in Catalog.GlobalEntities: Global.

ProbeLate.Description: Probe (ProjectTrack): Mounted by a route installer AFTER tenancy (late mount) WITH the tenancy column: Unguarded, never facetable.

ProbeLateGlobal.Description: Probe (ProjectTrack): Late mount without the tenancy column, in Catalog.GlobalEntities: Unguarded Global.

ProbeLink.Description: Probe (ProjectTrack): Installed (tenancy-guarded) table whose FKs point at every probe, so each probe is a label target and a parent hop.
